title: Term labour — admission for expected NVD (incl. poor progress, poor maternal effort)
population: Obstetric (≥ 37 weeks, singleton, cephalic, planned vaginal birth)
dagger_note: † = clinical or local addition, not in the SA guideline
item_format: t=text, s=source:printed page, d=dagger, b=bold, k=kind (check|value|yn|info|sub), h=heading

admission.title: Diagnosis of labour — contractions + any one

items.t: Regular painful uterine contractions, plus ≥ 1 of:
Suspected labour — observe up to 6 h
GA ____ wk · Contractions ____/10 min lasting ____ s · Cervix ____ cm · Head ____/5 · Time ____

admission.title: High-risk / abnormal labour = any one of

items.t: ROM > 12 h and still in the latent phase
Malpresentation: breech, transverse or oblique lie
CPD: 2+ or 3+ sagittal moulding with head not engaged, or severe caput
Suspected chorioamnionitis · impaired fetal growth · diabetes
Hb < 6 g/dL, or anaemia with symptoms
GA dating: early US / LMP / SFH

admission.title: Vitals and measurements
admission.note: Abnormal = outside adult norms or her own booking values

items.h: Fetal heart — before and after a contraction

items.t: < 6 g/dL in labour: transfuse ≥ 1 unit packed cells, 1 unit at a time
Symptomatic (dizzy, tachycardic, breathless at rest): transfuse
Low Hb: send FBC; avoid IV fluid overload
Plus urine dipstick: glucose, ketones, protein (protein + raised BP → pre-eclampsia pathway)
Test all who tested negative earlier or are unknown
HIV+ not on ART: TLD 1 tab + NVP stat; start ART next day
All women living with HIV: viral load at delivery; on ART → usual doses in labour
Syphilis RDT +: benzathine penicillin 2.4 MU IM + RPR; baby per newborn guideline

admission.title: Red flags to rule out on arrival

decision.t: 10. Diagnosis = HIGH-RISK LABOUR (§2) → stabilise, intrauterine resuscitation if needed, then REFER
11. LOW-RISK TERM LABOUR or SUSPECTED LABOUR → ADMIT to labour ward — stabilise, then continue on the term labour management chart and the 12-hour labour nursing record (plot on the MCR partogram)

chart.phase_note: Rows follow the stage of labour, not the clock — move to the next row when its criteria are met. ANDH: ventouse and Neopuff on site; no caesarean section or oxytocin augmentation → REFER. Plot every observation on the MCR partogram.

standing.t: FHR + maternal pulse 2-hourly · contractions 2-hourly · BP, RR, temp 6-hourly · VE 6-hourly · urine when passed
FHR + maternal pulse every 30 min · contractions 2-hourly · BP, RR, temp 4-hourly · VE 4-hourly, 2-hourly after 8 cm · urine when passed
Passive — as active phase, FHR every 30 min
Pushing — FHR every 5 min or after every 2nd contraction (whichever first) with maternal pulse; maternal vitals at onset; head descent (fifths) every 15 min
FHR before and after a contraction every time
Act on: FHR ≥ 180 or < 110 for 10 min · late decelerations for 10 min · single deceleration > 3 min

rows.label: Admission
rows.lead: Check the referral letter / card for treatment already given (analgesia, ART, penicillin) †. Risk-classify (admission pathway §2) and confirm labour.

feed.t: Low risk: eat and drink freely — no routine IV
Walk about in latent and early active phase
Any position except flat on her back
One companion of her choice; privacy; her own language
No routine enema, shaving, catheter or AROM

tests.t: Hb (meter)
Urine dipstick: glucose, ketones, protein
Rapid HIV + syphilis if negative earlier / unknown
Rh group if unknown; unbooked or no results: all booking bloods
WLHIV: viral load at delivery (sticker in RTHB)
TB symptom screen

treatment.t: Turn her off her back; 500 mL fluid bolus if dehydrated or hypotensive
Temp > 38: investigate and treat
Persisting: salbutamol 250 µg IV over 2 min (not if cardiac disease, maternal tachycardia, HT)
Fully dilated, head 0/5 → ventouse; otherwise REFER urgently
No maternal face-mask O₂ for the fetus
Fully dilated + head engaged → ventouse now
Else: push presenting part up, knee-elbow; catheter, fill bladder 400 mL NaCl 0.9%, clamp; IV line; salbutamol as above; REFER urgently
Transfuse ≥ 1 unit, 1 unit at a time
TLD 1 tab + NVP stat; ART next day

tests.t: Latent-phase frequencies (standing box)
VE after 4 h if no contractions palpable

treatment.t: Labour usually clear by 6 h
Not in labour + reassuring + no ROM + no cervical change → discharge (or waiting home) with warning signs and follow-up date

feed.t: Oral fluids and food. Analgesia on request.

tests.t: 2-hourly FHR, pulse, contractions; 6-hourly BP, RR, temp, VE
Earlier VE: contractions change, seems active, needs opiate, urge to push, non-reassuring
ROM → speculum (not VE), check FHR

treatment.t: Morphine 0.1 mg/kg IM 4-hourly PRN (max 10 mg) + promethazine 25 mg IM 4-hourly
REFER: MSL, ROM > 12 h, non-reassuring
Not 5 cm by 12 h: doctor review
> 24 h (prolonged): exclude abruptio, UTI, false labour, fetal distress, CPD → stretch & sweep, AROM; oxytocin needed → REFER

feed.t: Oral fluids. Empty bladder. Entonox or morphine.

tests.t: FHR + pulse every 30 min; contractions 2-hourly; BP, RR, temp 4-hourly
VE 4-hourly (2-hourly after 8 cm)
Partogram: first active entry on the alert line (from 5 cm, 1 cm/h); action line 2 h to the right

treatment.t: REFER: non-reassuring, MSL with delivery not imminent, poor progress, CPD (2+/3+ moulding and head not engaged, severe caput)
ROM > 12 h with good progress + reassuring: no referral needed

feed.t: NaCl 0.9% 200–300 mL IV bolus, then 120 mL/h; oral fluids

tests.t: 4 Ps: Patient (distress, pain, hydration, bladder, position) · Powers (contractions) · Passage · Passenger (size, lie, position, level, moulding, liquor)

treatment.t: CPD, malpresentation or fetal distress → REFER (caesarean)
None: support, mobilise, analgesia, AROM if intact
Reassess in 2 h

tests.t: Re-examine for CPD: moulding, descent (fifths), caput
Oxytocin would need continuous CTG

treatment.t: Primigravida, no CPD, no fetal distress: oxytocin augmentation — not done at ANDH → REFER
Multigravida or any CPD → REFER

feed.t: Empty bladder (catheter if needed). Upright or side.

tests.t: FHR every 30 min; other obs as active phase
Rule out CPD
Time fully dilated: ____

treatment.t: Wait for urge to push — do not start pushing without it
No urge at 1 h: confirm truly fully dilated; AROM if intact; still no urge → REFER (let her deliver if the urge comes while waiting)

feed.t: Position of her choice, not flat supine. Calm, kind, clear; praise effort; push only with contractions.

tests.t: FHR every 5 min or after every 2nd contraction, with pulse
Vitals at onset; head descent every 15 min (fifths — caput misleads)
Time pushing started: ____

treatment.t: Limit: para 0 = 45 min, para > 0 = 30 min of pushing (no CS on site)
Not delivered: head 0/5 + conditions met → ventouse; head ≥ 1/5 → REFER
Fetal or maternal compromise: act now, time limits do not apply

feed.t: Dry baby, skin-to-skin ≥ 1 h. Breastfeed within 1 h.

tests.t: Apgar at 1 and 5 min
Record times: full dilatation, pushing, birth; FHR during delivery
5-min Apgar < 7: cord blood gas if possible, placenta to histology, incident report, copy file/CTG

treatment.t: Episiotomy only if indicated (rigid perineum, fetal distress): lignocaine 1% max 3 mg/kg (usually ≤ 20 mL), mediolateral
Cord clamp at 1–3 min; early if baby needs resuscitation — Neopuff; ongoing support → REFER

tests.t: Palpate: no second twin
Placenta and membranes complete?
Inspect perineum, vagina: tear degree ____

treatment.t: Oxytocin 10 U IM immediately (after twin excluded)
Controlled cord traction when uterus contracts, guarding the uterus; no fundal massage to speed it
Not separating and no bleeding: wait, retry
Repair episiotomy / tear; 3rd/4th degree → REFER unless skilled doctor + theatre

feed.t: Skin-to-skin; offer a light meal at 2 h

tests.t: BP, pulse, RR, temp, pads, uterus every 15 min × 1 h, then every 30 min × 1 h (MCR page)
Cumulative blood loss every 15 min if a drape is used

treatment.t: PPH risk: consider oxytocin infusion 10–20 U in 1 L NaCl 0.9% — see PPH pathway
All obs normal → postnatal ward (after 1 h if no bed, same schedule)

feed.t: Mobile; passes urine. Breastfeeding position and attachment.

tests.t: On arrival: BP, pulse, uterus firm, no active bleeding
BP, pulse, temp, pads 4-hourly (early warning chart)
WLHIV: delivery VL sent; infant birth HIV PCR

treatment.t: Paracetamol 1 g PO for mild pain
Rh-neg + baby Rh-pos/unknown: anti-D 100 µg IM within 72 h
HIV-exposed baby: NVP + AZT per VTP guideline
Syphilis +: penicillin course; baby per newborn guideline

feed.t: Safe place to stay; companion present

tests.t: Discharge criteria (below)
All results recorded: Hb, syphilis, Rh, HIV

treatment.t: Criteria met → discharge; danger signs explained
Contraception counselled and provided
Not met → stay; call doctor for abnormal obs

tests.t: 4-hourly BP, pulse, temp, pads
Watch for infection: fever, uterine tenderness, offensive lochia

treatment.t: Infection risk (HIV, prolonged labour, prolonged ROM, chorioamnionitis): observe longer
New HIV+: start lifelong ART (TLD) day after delivery

items.t: Morphine 0.1 mg/kg IM 4-hourly PRN, max 10 mg, + promethazine 25 mg IM 4-hourly — latent to full dilatation
Entonox (50% N₂O / O₂) by mask in active labour
Oxytocin 10 U IM once no second twin
1 mL (0.5 mg) + 9 mL NaCl 0.9% = 50 µg/mL; give 5 mL (250 µg) IV over 2 min; stop if pulse > 120
REFER — needs continuous CTG and caesarean back-up
Truly fully dilated? Bladder empty? Membranes ruptured?
Pain, fear, exhaustion: support, analgesia, fluids, position change; kind, clear words — never shout or threaten
Informed + co-operative · vertex · head 0/5 (ANDH, no CS) · position certain · fully dilated · membranes ruptured · bladder empty · strong contractions
−0.6 to −0.8 bar, never beyond red zone; pull only with contractions
No descent with a pull · not delivered after 3 pulls · 2 cup detachments
No forceps after a failed ventouse
Action line crossed · CPD · malpresentation · previous CS
Fetal distress not deliverable by ventouse
Thick MSL (continuous CTG), delivery not imminent
Abandoned ventouse · no urge after passive 1 h
Call 2 helpers · McRoberts · suprapubic (never fundal) pressure · deliver posterior arm · all-fours · record head-to-body time
Bleeding → APH / PPH · BP raised → pre-eclampsia · fever, offensive liquor → chorioamnionitis: REFER
FHR act-on trigger · meconium · cord felt/seen · bleeding · BP, pulse or temp above booking baseline · urge to push · no progress at next VE · pushing limit reached

discharge.title: Discharge criteria — ≥ 6 h after birth, all must be met

items.t: Looks and feels well; no problems needing attention
No anaemia · no uterine tenderness · no active bleeding
Mobile, passed urine, no excessive pain
Hb, syphilis, Rh, HIV recorded and acted on
Safe place to stay · MCR checklist + discharge summary done
Clinic at 3–6 days (mother + baby), then 6 weeks
WLHIV: 2 months ART + 6 weeks infant prophylaxis; delivery VL checked at 3–6 days
Bleeding (> 2–3 pads in 20–30 min, or increasing), convulsions, fast breathing, fever too weak to stand, severe abdominal pain
Baby: difficult breathing, fits, fever/cold, not feeding

nursing.title: 12-hour labour nursing record — FHR, pulse, contractions, progress
nursing.period: One sheet per 12 hours; 30-min rows, heavier rule every 2 h; second-stage and fourth-stage strips

items.t: Pushing: every 5 min or after every 2nd contraction (strip below)
Urine when passed: volume, protein, ketones
Time fully dilated, time pushing started, limit (para 0: 45 min · para > 0: 30 min)
FHR + pulse every 5 min; head /5 every 15 min; birth time, Apgar
BP, pulse, RR, temp, uterus, pads every 15 min × 1 h, then 30 min × 1 h

call.t: Call the doctor for FHR ≥ 180 or < 110 for 10 min · late decelerations for 10 min · single deceleration > 3 min · meconium · cord felt or seen · vaginal bleeding · BP, pulse or temp above her booking baseline · urge to push · no progress at the next VE · pushing limit reached
